summary_cn: 2023 年 3 月 17 日收盘后,GICS 结构修订生效:Target、Dollar General、Dollar Tree 三家综合折扣零售商从可选消费迁入必需消费。同一次修订把旧的「食品与主要用品零售」(3010)更名为「必需消费分销与零售」,把可选消费的「零售业」(2550)更名为「可选消费分销与零售」——换名字是为了容纳这次搬家:分类依据从「卖什么店」改成「货架上主要是什么」。同一天生效的还有支付网络迁入金融服务,两张卡片说的是同一次重组。
summary_en: Effective after the close on 2023-03-17, the revised GICS structure moved three broadline discounters — Target, Dollar General and Dollar Tree — from Consumer Discretionary into Consumer Staples. The same revision renamed group 3010 from Food & Staples Retailing to Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail, and group 2550 from Retailing to Consumer Discretionary Distribution & Retail. The renaming is what made the move possible: the test shifted from what kind of store it is to what is mostly on its shelves. The payment networks moved into Financial Services the same day — the two cards describe one restructuring.
context_cn: 读者要记住的一件事:这条边界是会动的,所以任何跨 2023-03-17 的板块长序列都带着一个口径接缝。我们不把两段拼接、也不回溯重算——XLP 与 XLY 的历史曲线画的是各自当时的口径,这张卡片就是那道接缝的说明。三家搬家公司合计约占 XLY 迁出前权重的个位数百分比,但它们把必需消费的零售一侧从「超市 + 会员店」扩成了「超市 + 会员店 + 折扣百货」。
context_en: The line moves, and that is the thing to carry away: any long sector series spanning 2023-03-17 contains a definitional seam. We neither splice the two regimes nor restate the history — the XLY and XLP curves show each period on the definition in force at the time, and this card is the note on the seam. The three names were a single-digit share of XLY's weight on the way out, but they widened the retail side of Staples from supermarkets and warehouse clubs to supermarkets, warehouse clubs and broadline discounters.
